title: Algerian Tagine Chicken
description: A traditional Algerian dish made with slow-cooked chicken in a flavorful tagine sauce.

ingredients.name: Algerian tagine
ingredients.notes: You can use other types of clay cookers or adjust seasoning accordingly

ingredients.name: jazzy spice blend
ingredients.notes: You can adjust according to taste

instructions: Heat the oil in the tagine or a Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, almonds, and jazzy spice blend. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, tomato paste, and salt. Stir to combine.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
